notes.title: Patch #5 - Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Quality of Life Update
[/b][/h1][h2][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Weapons now have a chance to drop with an increase to a rank to any of your skills (regardless if you have them learned or not)[/p][list][*][p]Maximum 1 Skill and up to 1 rank at Level 10[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum 2 Skills and up to 2 ranks at Level 20[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum 3 Skills and up to 3 ranks at Level 30[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added the Wardrobe system[/p][list][*][p]You can now set your armor and weapon to look like any appearance you have collected[/p][/*][*][p]You have to equip the items for them to register into the wardrobe (even if you have them currently equipped)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Classes now gain bonus stats every level and every 5 levels respectively[/p][list][*][p]Warrior - Gains an extra 10 Maximum Health every Level as well as 1% Defense every 5 Levels[/p][/*][*][p]Ranger - Gains an extra 5 Maximum Health and Mana every Level as well as 1% Critical Damage every 5 Levels[/p][/*][*][p]Mage - Gains an extra 10 Maximum Mana every Level as well as 1% Cooldown Reduction[/p][/*][*][p]All of these stat upgrades will be updated retroactively[/p][/*][*][p]Added auto sort button to Inventory, sorting your items by category (the same button will added to the Bank next patch) [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Changes to Chat:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Chat channels have now been separated to the following:[/p][/*][*][p]Default is the Say channel which is activated by /s - Displays your text in a bubble to players around you[/p][/*][*][p]Yell is now a channel for your entire zone, so if you are exploring in Azura and do /y - It will display your text to all players in the zone [/p][/*][*][p]Whisper chat has been improved slightly with a new color scheme and you can use /r to reply to the last person that whispered you[/p][/*][/list][p]Finally, from now on pressing Enter or any other keybind for chat, you will be able to automatically start typing instead of having to click on the chatbox[/p]

notes.title: Major Patch #1 - Level 30, 2 New Zones, Mounts and more
notes.content:
[h1][b]Level 30 | 2 New Zones | Mounts | Banking System | 18 New Abilities [/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Here is what you can expect from this Patch:[/b][/h2][olist][*][p]Max Level increased to 30[/p][/*][*][p]2 New Zones to complete the story of the Cerulean Forest[/p][/*][*][p]First iteration of Mounts[/p][/*][*][p]New passive and active abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Bank System[/p][/*][*][p]General bugfixes and UI improvements[/p][/*][/olist][h2][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Increased mob strength in new zones - they deal more damage and have more HP[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced spawn rate of these stronger mobs to balance traveling through the zone[/p][/*][*][p]Added Bubulle Bank to Azura and Methylvale towns - you have 60 slots to begin with and you can buy more slots with in-game gold up to 120 slots[/p][/*][*][p]Reminder from last patch: Your character now no longer rotates to your nearest target, instead you have to turn your character so you can hit enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Increase all spell rank upgrades to rank 10 to allow you for more focused builds[/p][/*][*][p]Side Quests now also have markers on the map to show where your objective is located[/p][/*][*][p]Added new keybind option in settings for mounting up - Mounts have a cast time and you will be interrupted if attacked. You will be dismounted if you're hit a few times or if you cast an ability (you can still use potions while in mount form)[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Cerulean Forest North and North East:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Complete the final leg of the Cerulean Forest story within these 2 zones[/p][/*][*][p]Meet new and interesting characters across the Forest and help them with their objectives[/p][/*][*][p]New major boss in the form of the Shtunking[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock the first ever mount in the game by completing the quest "Ancient Techniques" allowing you to transform into the Almighty Chicken form[/p][/*][*][p]Harvest new materials which give you more materials per harvest including things like Life and Mana flowers[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]New Abilities:
[/b][/h2][h3]Warrior:[/h3][olist][*][p]Relentless Endurance - Each time you kill an enemy your Health regeneration is increased by X for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Vampiric Strikes - Your Slash now heals for X% damage done.[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stand - If an attack would reduce you to 0 Health, instead heal X% Maximum Health.[/p][/*][*][p]Rupture - Slam your weapon to the ground releasing a shockwave dealing X damage in an area around you.[/p][/*][*][p]Open Wound - Open the wounds of your foes to deal X damage x Bleed stacks and increases danage done by Bleeds by 5% for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Bone Shatter - Crush the bones of your enemies and deal X damage, increasing their damage taken by 5% for 10 seconds.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3]Mage: [/h3][olist][*][p]Cauterize - If a target is ablaze within 10 units of you, restore X Health per second.[/p][/*][*][p]Arcane Endurance - While Mage Shield is active heal based on X% of your total Mana each second.[/p][/*][*][p]Cold Shoulder - If you get hit while your Mage Shield is active stun enemies for 0.5 seconds. Restore X Shield per second.[/p][/*][*][p]Ice Beam - Embrace the Frost Dragon and project a deadly beam of Frost dealing X damage to the first target hit and consuming 2% Maximum Mana per second.[/p][/*][*][p]Arcane Shards - Manifest the Arcane itself into multiple projectiles hitting up to 5 enemies dealing X damage per shard.[/p][/*][*][p]Burning Nova - Burn the air around you dealing X damage, deals more damage based on how many enemies are affected by Blaze by X% up to X%.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3]Ranger:[/h3][olist][*][p]Into The Fray - While Entangling Block is active you heal X Health Per Second.[/p][/*][*][p]Leeching Poison - If more than one target is affected by your Poison heal X Health Per Second for the duration.[/p][/*][*][p]BunkerDown - Standing still for more than 3 seconds restores X Health Per Second while standing still.[/p][/*][*][p]Assassinate - Slash your target with great force dealing X damage, Assassinate deals 50% more damage to enemies above 90% and under 10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Lesion - Focus your shot on a targets wound dealing X damage times poison stacks on the target. Increases damage done by poisons by 5% for 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Killshot - Pull your bow for 2 seconds, dealing X to the target you have marked for death. If the target is Crowd Controlled, they take an extra 20% damage.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed server lag issues that were caused by mob animations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rings not getting equipped when using Auto-Select option in inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed War Mode UI[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple visual issues regarding spells, like leaving fragments stuck on enemies[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]News regarding Android version:[/b][/h2][h3]We have unfortunately encountered a verification issue with our Google Play account, which caused Naica to be removed from the Play Store.[/h3][p][/p][h3]We are working on a fix so you can continue to play Naica on Android. Sorry for the inconvenience <3[/h3]

notes.title: News - Patch #4 Teaser
notes.content: [h3]What to expect in Patch #4 - Our first Major patch[/h3][p]Greetings fellow Naicalites, we've been cooking up a lot of stuff behind the scenes, and before we release our next update we'd like to give you a bit of an update of what is going on from our side as well as what to expect in the next Patch, coming soon to the Live servers![/p][p][/p][p][b]Main Additions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]2 new zones which will complete the storyline of the Cerulean Forest in preparation for the next chapter of your adventures[/p][/*][*][p]Level cap will be increased to 30 which will unlock a new active and passive ability [/p][/*][*][p]New gear set for the level 30 bracket[/p][/*][*][p]You will be able to obtain your first mount upon completing a specific quest[/p][/*][*][p]Bank with 60 slots, which will be upgradeable to 120 with Gold you have earned in-game[/p][/*][*][p]Mana and Health Potion cooldown reduction upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Based on popular demand Side Quests now have a map visual showing you where you need to go, Board Quests will still have no map visual since they are designed to be accomplished as you are moving through the zones[/p][/*][*][p]Tons of bug fixes and balance changes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Next few patches after Patch #4 you can expect:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adding a wardrobe system, where you will be able to equip items which will override the visual of the gear you are currently wearing, without affecting stats[/p][/*][*][p]New ability scaling system which will allow abilities to go past rank 5, up to 10[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of a cash shop with only cosmetics at the beginning and as we further develop in-game systems we will most likely add certain convenience elements as well [b](NO P2W)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Expansion of the Tower Arenas as well as the addition of proper instanced dungeons that you can explore and conquer with a party of 5[/p][/*][*][p]World Bosses - Dangerous enemies that will occasionally spawn on the world map and will require cooperation and coordination from dozens of players to take down[/p][/*][/list][p][b]A few updates on our side:[/b][/p][list][*][p]We are very happy with the feedback we've received for the game, what you love, what you hate, we take anything we can into account to make the experience better for all of you[/p][/*][*][p]We have also realized that with the reworked foundation of Naica, came new and unexpected challenges which lead us to not publish updates as fast as we wanted to, but that will slowly start to level out thanks to a new addition to our team![/p][list][*][p]Another team member has been added to our humble 3 person roster, so once they get caught up with everything (which should take at least a month or two) - expect more agile and frequent updates[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]And last but not least, we'd like to extend a huge thank you to everyone who helped us report and resolve bugs, all the people that left reviews, ESPECIALLY the awesome and entertaining conversations happening on our Discord server, so big hugs from everyone at Naica <3[/b][/p]

notes.title: Naica Online - Patch #3 | Class Balancing and Open World PvP
notes.content: [h1][b]Class Balancing and Open World PvP[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2][b]Here is what you can expect from this Patch:[/b][/h2][olist][*][p]Class balancing across the board[/p][/*][*][p]New targeting system[/p][/*][*][p]The introduction of opt in World PvP[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of duels[/p][/*][*][p]Item drop balancing[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][/olist][h2][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Changed targeting system to make using abilities more fluid and logical[/p][list][*][p]Abilities now won't automatically turn the character if the target is in a direction the player is not facing[/p][/*][*][p]Cone and line abilities are now aimed where the player is facing[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Disabled opening player interaction UI when in combat to prevent unnecessary opening of the menu [/p][/*][*][p]Added new visual for AOE effects[/p][/*][*][p]Changed ability cooldown visual to add decimal points[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Introduction to PvP:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Implemented the option for players to opt into open world PvP currently named War Mode[/p][/*][*][p]You can activate PvP by talking to a pile of bones named "[b]Bravados[/b]" in any NPC hub to enable or disable war mode[/p][list][*][p]Anyone who opted in to the system will be able to PvP each other anywhere in the open world apart from "Safe Zones" which are NPC/Quest hubs like the various towns and camps on the map[/p][/*][*][p]You will not lose experience if you die from player damage, but you do get experience for eliminating other players[/p][/*][*][p]Healing and Mana regeneration is lowered in PvP scenarios to prevent drawn out combat encounters[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Duels[/p][list][*][p]When out of combat, click on a player and you will see the Duel option[/p][/*][*][p]After initiating a duel, a flag will be dropped between the players which is used as an anchor for the duel[/p][/*][*][p]If you move too far away from the flag you will be prompted to return with a 5 second timer, if you do not return you will lose the duel[/p][/*][*][p]You do not have to have PvP enabled to engage in Duels[/p][/*][*][p]The duel ends when one of the players reaches 1% HP - you get a small boost of health and all damage over time effects are removed immediately[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Future of PvP[/b][/p][list][*][p]Currently we are working on a reward system for PvP which will include PvP exclusive gear[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities are still balanced around PvE encounters, but with the new gear system we plan to add this would alleviate that issue[/p][/*][*][p]When this new system is implemented, if you PvP with normal PvE gear you will deal significantly less damage unless you're wearing PvP gear which you will be able to buy from an NPC[/p][/*][*][p]You will be able to target each gear slot as you wish, where when you buy the item it will drop with a random assortment of stats (like PvE gear, but from a vendor), it will always include PvP power and PvP defense though[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]Class Balance Changes:[/b][/h2][h3][b]Warrior:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Slash - No changes[/p][/*][*][p]Block - No longer reduces damage from enemies 6 levels above the player[/p][/*][*][p]Bleeding Edge - Now properly stacks bleed effects below and after Rank 5[/p][/*][*][p]Whirlwind - Reduced damage and increased cooldown to 5 seconds to compensate for Rank 5 effect being very strong[/p][/*][*][p]Crushing Blow - Reduced cooldown to 2 seconds, increased mana cost but increased damage slightly to compensate[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaving Strike - No changes[/p][/*][*][p]Wounding Strike - Now properly deals extra damage to bleeding enemies [/p][/*][*][p]Penetrating Strike - Now properly applies armor reduction debuff increasing overall damage[/p][/*][*][p]Sharp Block - Enemies only take 1 stack of bleed per shield activation to prevent fast bleed stacking[/p][/*][*][p]Explosive Block - Now properly stores damage and releases it when the effect expires[/p][/*][*][p]Retaliating Block - No changes[/p][/*][*][p]Bleeding Slash - At Rank 5 now properly consumes bleed stacks to deal extra damage (damage x bleed stacks) - example 100x5 stacks = 500dmg[/p][/*][*][p]Slam - Increased mana cost and increased damage[/p][/*][*][p]Piercing Strike - Reduced mana cost and increased damage, changed Rank 5 ability to now increase damage done by AOE spells regardless of how many enemies it hits[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Mage:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Key change - separated Ablaze effects from Firebolt and other spells from Dragon Breath[/p][list][*][p]Firebolt - Separated Ablaze effect from Dragon Breath to deal less ticking damage[/p][/*][*][p]Dragon Breath - Reduced initial damage, increased tick damage and enemies now properly explode when under the Dragon Breath Ablaze effect[/p][/*][*][p]Arcane Spear -  Reduced mana cost, increased cooldown to 5 but also increased damage[/p][/*][*][p]Falling Elements - Changed from Fire to Frost damage with added new Frosted effect, also reduced mana cost [/p][/*][*][p]Arcane Affinity - Now properly applies Arcane Bolt and Rank 5 passive that increases damage done based on how low your mana is, reduced mana cost as well as cooldown to 1.75 and increased damage [/p][/*][*][p]Frost Affinity - Now properly applies Frosted effect, frosted effect slow reduced to 30%, reduced mana cost as well as cooldown to 1.75 on Frostbolt, slightly increased damage[/p][/*][*][p]Critical Fire - Now properly applies to only Firebolt[/p][/*][*][p]Shield Lens - Now properly applies critical bonus damage [/p][/*][*][p]Frosted Shield - Now properly applies Frosted and Rank 5 effects[/p][/*][*][p]Blazing Shield - Now properly applies Ablaze effect [/p][/*][*][p]Arcane Nova - Slightly reduced mana cost and increased damage[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Firebolt - Mana cost and damage reduced, Rank 5 effect now properly stacks damage[/p][/*][*][p]Ice Knives - Increased range, reduced mana cost, and improved visual effect of the level 5 ability[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Ranger:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Bow Shot - Reduced hit circle from 360 degrees to 180 cone in front of the player[/p][/*][*][p]Poison Arrow - Slightly increased mana cost, reduced initial hit damage, increased poison tick damage[/p][/*][*][p]Snipers Nest - Increased mana cost, increased cooldown to 7 seconds, increased damage and range[/p][/*][*][p]Fan of Knives - Increased damage and range [/p][/*][*][p]Weakness Poison - Now properly applies extra damage to Bowshot[/p][/*][*][p]Dagger Master - Increased Dagger attack damage[/p][/*][*][p]Patient Shot - Patient shot now properly applies aura, added a grace period of 3 seconds after moving where the effect doesn't disappear[/p][/*][*][p]Vial Break - Now deals flat damage instead of scaling damage[/p][/*][*][p]Block Wave - Now deals flat damage, and triggers animation/stun properly[/p][/*][*][p]Piercing Block - No changes[/p][/*][*][p]Crippling Arrow - At Rank 5 now properly consumes poison stacks to deal extra damage (damage x bleed stacks) - example 100x5 stacks = 500dmg[/p][/*][*][p]Behind You - Reworked ability, can now be casted from anywhere, but deals more damage if hitting an enemy from behind. New Rank 5 addition deals 20% extra damage to crowd controlled enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Arrow Rain - No changes[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed keybinds like Escape and Tab closing their associated menus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where certain crashes would not save character to the database properly leading to lost progress (if this issue affected you, please contact us on Discord so that we may at least restore some of your character progress)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Manji wood drop rate - added it to PsyManji loot pool as well[/p][/*][*][p]You're only able to loot weapons related to your class to prevent inventory clutter[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where in certain PvP encounters players wouldn't be able to move[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Whirlwind consuming too much mana because of tick rate[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Naica Online - Bug Fix Patch #2
notes.content: [h3][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased follow distance for all mobs - Mobs will now follow you for longer which will allow you to better kite them and engage in safer combat[/p][/*][*][p]Monsters now quickly regenerate Health when you disengage combat with them[/p][/*][*][p]Added new Area of Effect visual for AOE spells like Falling Elements[/p][/*][*][p]Mage Shield now gives you 50% of your maximum health as a shield[/p][list][*][p]Increased duration to 5 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Increased cooldown to 7 seconds[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Optimized certain game elements that were causing server side lag[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing the logout button now correctly takes you back to the character selection screen[/p][/*][*][p]Mana potion cooldown is now properly 10 seconds as it should be[/p][/*][*][p]"The Sting" quest should now properly count only the Elite Swarm Bee and reduced count to 1[/p][/*][*][p]"Power Surge" quest can now be taken properly[/p][/*][*][p]"A Proper Farewell" quest now has correct Roak wood attached so the quest can be completed[/p][/*][*][p]Removed certain quests from being repeatable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing animation for Wood Sword[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Elite Flapdoy animations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bug Report window being closed when pressing certain keys[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue when putting volume slider to a minimum, sound is now properly reduced to a 0[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where certain mob projectiles would disappear while also hitting the player[/p][/*][*][p]Removed obsolete armor stat from the game and existing gear[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Naica Online - Patch #2 | Level 20 and New Zone
notes.content: [h1][b]Level 20, New Abilities, New Zone[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]Here is what you can expect from this Patch:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]More than 10 new quests[/p][/*][*][p]New, stronger enemies[/p][/*][*][p]New and dangerous areas[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocking your third active ability[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfixes and balance changes[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added party debuff modifier to lower experience while gathering and killing monsters by 10% per player in party to balance the speed playing in a party gives[/p][/*][*][p]Added unique XP modifier for certain mobs depending on their difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now reach level 20[/p][/*][*][p]Potion cooldown increased to 10 seconds[/p][list][*][p]In a later patch we will add the option to reduce the cooldown at their respective NPCs[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Set a cap on Job levels to be as same as player level[/p][/*][*][p]Changed cooldown/duration of multiple abilities[/p][list][*][p]Falling Elements 6->10[/p][/*][*][p]Level 5 Piercing Block Stun 5->1.5[/p][/*][*][p]Entangling Block root duration 2->1[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reduced the amount of stats given per item[/p][list][*][p]Common (White): 1-2[/p][/*][*][p]Uncommon (Green): 1-3[/p][/*][*][p]Rare (Blue): 2-4[/p][/*][*][p]Epic (Purple): 2-5[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Various abilities have had their damage altered across all classes[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed white item box issue preventing player movement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed second quest issue where it wouldn't trigger upon shield use[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potion cost displayed after reaching a certain threshold[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed world elements like Crab Boss and Arena event from not triggering[/p][/*][*][p]Altered stat system to scale better[/p][/*][*][p]Now only party members are able to resurrect each other[/p][/*][*][p]Cannot try and equip weapons of other classes[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of quest text fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Certain mobs now properly count towards quest progression[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed that one pesky Shrub mob[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Naica Online - Bug Fix Patch #1
notes.content: [h2][b]Most important changes:[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]XP Loss will now only scale up to the maximum experience you need to get to the next level[/p][list][*][p]So if it takes 10,000 experience from level 12 to 13, and you die multiple times on your journey to level 13 you will only be able to accumulate 10,000 experience[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sharp Block now only applies 1 stack of Bleed[/p][/*][*][p]Exploding block now properly deals damage, animation is still broken at the moment, working on a fix![/p][/*][*][p]Enemies 6 levels above you will most likely instantly kill you from now on[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tooltips should now properly disappear after closing your inventory/menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Crab Boss room and tower arena to properly respawn even if no players are around[/p][/*][*][p]Wands and bows should now correctly drop on the loot table if you're playing Mage or Ranger classes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Naica Online - Patch #1 | Added Mage and Ranger Classes
notes.content: [h2]Patch #1 - Naica Online Early Access[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Mage class:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Embrace the path of the arcane and cast your enemies to dust[/p][/*][*][p]At Level 1 you have access to Firebolt which deals magic damage and can set enemies ablaze[/p][/*][*][p]Protect yourself with an arcane shield worthy of an adventurer like you[/p][/*][*][p]During your leveling journey you will be able to augment Firebolt with either Arcane or Frost power to help you fulfill your Mage fantasy[/p][/*][*][p]Whichever path you choose, remember to keep your mana full![/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Ranger class:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Take up your bow, and shoot your enemies from afar, or, at Level 5, pick the path of the Dagger and get up close and personal.[/p][/*][*][p]Be the master of strings, poisons or daggers while swiftly evading your enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Entagle your foes with with your quick escape tactics and blocking damage[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bugfixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed server crash issue related to Arena Tower activation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Crab boss not respawning and not letting players enter his arena properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed client side crash related to other player interaction[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Naica Online - Early Access Release
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome one and all to the release of Naica Online![/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]Here is what you can expect from the first version of Early Access release:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]One Class - Warrior[/p][/*][*][p]4 different races[/p][/*][*][p]More than 50 quests[/p][/*][*][p]Level Cap of 15[/p][/*][*][p]3 fully developed zones (with more content planned for each)[/p][/*][*][p]Various Bosses and Elite mobs to encounter[/p][/*][*][p]Foundations for various systems like Harvesting, Alchemy and Item Upgrades/Recycling[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Here is what you can expect in the coming weeks after release:[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614438/60df7413e1abfaf0e7f1e353110718c91606f5ee.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Any immediate issues will be addressed during the first week to the best of our ability[/p][/*][*][p]We will be reading any and all reviews as well as suggestions and feedback to make the game as best it can be for you![/p][/*][*][p]Implementing content we have planned and internally tested in a staggered manner[/p][/*][*][p]Reactivation and making use of the existing Naica social media channels to communicate and inform you, the players[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Everything you need to know heading into the game for the first time![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Warrior class available at launch[/b][/p][list][*][p]Take up your sword and face your enemies head on with the Warrior Class[/p][/*][*][p]At Level 15 you will have 3 active abilities including your Main Attack, a defensive Shield and your pick at 3 different active abilities with varying playstyles[/p][/*][*][p]You can explore the talent tree all the way up to Level 50 so you can see what we will be adding in future updates[/p][/*][*][p]You will also be able to choose one of 3 passive abilities which supplement the playstyle you chose to go with[/p][/*][*][p]Talent reroll potions will be available in Fred's shop so you can freely play around with different builds[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Enemy types[/b][/p][list][*][p]Currently there are 3 main enemy types in the game which include the following:[/p][list][*][p]Fighter: Fighters are your basic enemies with the most well-rounded stats to challenge you on your way to max level[/p][/*][*][p]Assassin: Assassins have lower health, but higher armor, attack and move faster, but deal less damage to you overall[/p][/*][*][p]Tank: Tanks have higher health, lower armor, they move and attack slower, but they hit [b]VERY[/b] hard[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Apart from the main 3 enemy types, you will also encounter Bosses and Elite mobs while exploring the world, you will notice them by the special mark under their name, and them being generally larger than most other mobs[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Armor/Weapons and stats:[/b][/p][list][*][p]During your leveling journey all enemies have a chance to drop gear, currently there are two sets available to loot which include the Wood and Metal armor sets. Wood set drops from level 1 and the Metal armor set drops from level 10 and beyond.[/p][/*][*][p]Different armor sets that drop only affect your character visually, it doesn't matter how it looks or how its named, the stats allocated are affected by the features explained below[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrading and recycling armor is a core feature of the game where you have the opportunity to pick and choose which armor to recycle or upgrade[/p][list][*][p]The stats that an item has is determined by 3 things, the level at which the item drops, its rarity and its rank[/p][/*][*][p]Rarity and rank follow the classic progression curve of White = Common, Green = Uncommon etc.[/p][/*][*][p]If you upgrade an item to its maximum rank (marked by an orange crown), the next upgrade will take the item to the next rarity level, further increasing its stats, but will not be able to be upgraded more[/p][/*][*][p]So a level 10 uncommon item with blue rank will always have lower stats than a level 10 rare item with no rank [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stagger mechanic:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Different enemy types have different stagger levels, meaning if you damage a Fighter mob under a certain % of Health, they will be stunned[/p][/*][*][p]The % of health required to trigger stagger and the duration of stagger varies per mob type[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]XP Loss mechanic:[/b][/p][list][*][p]If you perish in the world of Naica, the experience you have gathered in a level will be taken away and put into a pool of experience which will appear at the top of your screen[/p][/*][*][p]During this time you gain 100% experience from all sources until you have exhausted the entire pool of experience, this stacks infinitely[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Partying up and Friends:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can invite other players to join your party, and add them to your friends list[/p][/*][*][p]While in a party other members of the party can revive you if you die, but you will not regain the experience lost[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Magical Gates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]During your travels, you will come across magical blue gates, which you will use Dungeon Tickets in order to open[/p][/*][*][p]These areas are usually filled with dangerous creatures that you will need help eradicating, so be careful before you enter one of these areas[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Exploration:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]There are 3 fully developed areas that you can explore:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Methylvale: The start point of your adventure. Here you will get slowly introduced to the world of Naica and its denizens, collecting resources and helping anyone you can along the way. Defeat the terrible Crab Monster to save the villagers from living in fear[/p][/*][*][p]Azura: The central zone where your true Adventure begins, taking parts from Methylvale as well as 3 other neighboring zones to give you a feeling of what is to come in future updates[/p][/*][*][p]Cerulean Forest: This luscious forest will serve as the next big step in your adventure with only the first part of three being open for exploration[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]After reaching Azura, you will be able to find randomly placed loot chests all around the map in hidden nooks and crannies[/p][/*][*][p]Interacting with certain objects will give you more information and lore about the world of Naica[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Questing:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]You will encounter 3 main types of quests[/b][/p][list][*][p]Main Quest - These quests can be noticed by their Orangeish/Yellow color and serve to progress the main story of Naica to uncover the mysteries of what has been happening to the denizens of this place and put an end to it once and for all[/p][/*][*][p]Side Quests - These quests serve to expand the world of Naica, and for you, the adventurer to help your average citizen with tasks they are unable to complete because of the state of the world. They are marked as green[/p][/*][*][p]Board Quests - You will encounter a board when you reach Azura, which has various requests from the denizens of Naica, simple tasks like checking up statues to collecting rare materials and delivering them back to the Board. They are marked as Purple[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Professions:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]You will be able to collect various materials around Naica, mainly focused on natural resources like Flowers, Trees and Ore[/b][/p][list][*][p]Certain flowers like Life and Mana flowers are used to upgrade your potions at the main 2 alchemy related NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]We have implemented harvesting in order to fully flesh out those professions as gathering and we have planned somewhere down to line to make use of those materials through either crafting professions or having assistance from NPCs to help progress your character[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Content planned for the near future after release:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Two new classes which include the Mage and the Ranger[/p][/*][*][p]At least one new race[/p][/*][*][p]New zones which expand upon the Main Quest storyline[/p][/*][*][p]Increasing the Level Cap as we add more zones and content to the game[/p][/*][*][p]Open World Bosses, Dungeons and Arenas[/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Addressing the elephants:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Previous Naica releases:[/b][/p][list][*][p]As some of you may know there were previous iterations of Naica released to mixed reviews to say the least[/p][/*][*][p]This version hopes to alleviate all the pain points from the past and build upon the foundation of the beautiful and colorful world that is Naica[/p][/*][*][p]How will we do that you may ask? Well, with your help, through these points:[/p][list][*][p]Active communication on Steam reviews/forums, Google Play Store reviews and most importantly Discord[/p][/*][*][p]Taking reviews and feedback seriously to make the game a more enjoyable experience[/p][/*][*][p]Proactively make changes that benefit the game[/p][/*][*][p]Addressing any important issues as fast as we possibly can (we're still 3 people after all)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Monetization:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Yes, the game will have an in-game shop featuring cosmetics, quality of life features and certain types of progression boosters[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay design hasn't been focused around the existence of the shop[/p][/*][*][p]The shop will be implemented [b]ONLY[/b] when we are sure the game and community are stable enough for us to integrate the shop in a proper manner[/p][/*][*][p]We are also looking into monetization models that respect all playstyles and do not punish players for not logging in every single day - games should be fun, not a job[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for taking the time to read all of this, you are a legend, now go and explore the world of Naica <3

- Sincerely, Naica Dev Team[/p]
